1.name: January 17, 2026
1.overview: Promociones Antonio Peña, S.A. de C.V. d/b/a Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (commonly referred to as simply AAA, pronounced "triple A" – an abbreviation of its original name Asistencia, Asesoría y Administración de Espectáculos, 'Attendance, Advisory, and Administration of Spectacles') is a Mexican Lucha Libre (professional wrestling) promotion based in Mexico City, Mexico. It was founded in 1992, when Antonio Peña broke away from Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) to set up his own promotion to have more creative freedom. On April 19, 2025 it was announced that AAA had been acquired by WWE.

1.name: January 24, 2026
1.overview: AAA Tag Team Champions Psycho Clown & Pagano vs. Motor City Machine Guns vs. Tokyo Bad Boys vs. NGDAAA, Latin American Champion El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr vs. Mecha Wolf, and AAA Cruiserweight Champion Laredo Kid vs. Octagón Jr. vs. Mini Vikingo.

1.name: January 31, 2026
1.overview: This episode of Lucha Libre AAA features La Parka vs. Aerostar vs. Jack Cartwheel vs. Apollo Crews in a Rey de Reyes Qualifying Math, Lola Vice vs. La Hiedra (with Mr. Iguana as special referee), and TJP vs. Mini Vikingo, vs. Elio LeFleur vs. Chris Carter in a AAA Cruiserweight No. 1 Contenders Match.

1.name: February 7, 2026
1.overview: Mega Champion Dominik Mysterio will kick off the episode. Plus, AAA Mixed Tag Team Champions Ethan Page & La Hiedra vs. Mr. Iguana & Lola Vice, El Grande Americano vs. Rey Fenix vs. Dragon Lee vs. Octagon Jr. in a Rey de Reyes Qualifying Match.

1.name: February 14, 2026
1.overview: A match to determine the number one contender for the AAA Tag Team Championship between The War Raiders vs. The Money Machine vs. Los Americanos. Las Tóxicas vs. Faby Apache, Jessy Jackson, and Adelicious. La Parka vs. Jack Cartwheel, in a one-on-one match from Querétaro, Mexico.

1.name: February 21, 2026
1.overview: Dominik Mysterio and El Hijo del Vikingo come face-to-face in a Mega Title Contract Signing, AAA Latin American Champion El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. battles Belcegor and AAA Cruiserweight Champion Laredo Kid takes on T.J. Perkins in a pair of title matches, and El Fiscal steps in the ring with Abismo Negro.

1.name: February 28, 2026
1.overview: El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr., Pimpinela Escarlata, Omos, and Ethan Page battle it out in a Rey de Reyes Fatal 4-Way Qualifying Match. Plus, El Grande Americano promises to expose “Original” El Grande Americano and Dragon Lee battles Jack Cartwheel in a AAA World Cruiserweight Championship No 1. Contender's Match.

1.name: Rey de Reyes | March 14, 2026
1.overview: Week 1 of AAA Rey de Reyes kicks off with WWE Intercontinental Champion Penta. Plus, AAA Mega Champion Dominik Mysterio vs. El Hijo del Vikingo in a high-stakes No DQ Match, La Parka, “Original” El Grande Americano, Santos Escobar, and El Grande Americano in the finals of the Rey de Reyes Tournament, and Flammer’s AAA Reina de Reinas Title Open Challenge.

1.name: Rey de Reyes | March 21, 2026
1.overview: El Grande Americano wins the Rey de Reyes tournament and is set to celebrate as he receives the sword. Psycho Clown and Pagano must put their differences aside to face Los War Raiders for the AAA Tag Team Championship, while Rey Fénix teams up with Lola Vice and Mr. Iguana to take on La Hiedra, Garra de Oro, and Colmillo de Plata.

1.name: Rey de Reyes | March 28, 2026
1.overview: AAA Rey de Reyes rolls on as El Hijo del Vikingo looks to call out WWE Intercontinental Champion Penta. Plus, AAA World Cruiserweight Champion Laredo Kid will be challenged by Jack Cartwheel, TJ Perkins, and Dragon Lee in a Fatal Four-Way Match and El Fiscal takes on Abismo Negro.

1.name: May 9, 2026
1.overview: On the latest episode of Lucha Libre AAA, Psycho Clown will call out Pagano, Lince Dorado, Octagón Jr., and Cruz Del Toro battle it out in a Triple Threat Match, and La Catalina takes on Jessy Jackson.

1.name: May 16, 2026
1.overview: The Creed Brothers are causing chaos, but Aerostar and El Fiscal are ready to fight back, including a shocking ending involving Los Grandes Americanos. Galeno gets ready for a 2-on-1 match while catching the attention of a member of El Ojo. Plus, Mr. Iguana and La Parka team up to dive into a wild match against Los Money Machine, La NGD, and Los Tokyo Bad Boys.

1.name: May 23, 2026
1.overview: On the latest episode of Lucha Libre AAA, AAA President Marisela Peña will make the highly-anticipated General Manager Announcement. Plus, Los Americanos Hermanos take on Los Americanos and Laredo Kid battles Rey Fenix in a AAA World Cruiserweight Championship Match.

1.name: Noche de Los Grandes: May 30, 2026
1.overview: AAA Noche de Los Grandes Week 1 will see El Grande Americano battle “Original” El Grande Americano in a Mask vs. Mask Match. Plus, three titles will be contested as AAA Latin American Champion El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. takes on El Hijo del Vikingo, AAA World Tag Team Champion Pagano & Psycho Clown lock horns with The War Raiders, and AAA World Cruiserweight Champion Laredo Kid goes to war with Rey Fénix.

1.name: Noche de Los Grandes: June 6, 2026
1.overview: AAA Noche de Los Grandes roars on with NXT Women’s Champion and AAA World Mixed Tag Team Champion Lola Vice, Bayley and La Catalina taking on Reina de Reinas Champion Lady Flammer, La Hiedra and Maravilla of Las Tóxicas. Plus, the New AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio to address AAA Lucha Libre and Mini Vikingo, Octagón Jr., Joaquin Wilde, Cruz Del Toro and Lince Dorado to battle in a AAA Cruiserweight Title No. 1 Contender's Fatal 5-Way Match

1.name: June 13, 2026
1.overview: AAA World Mixed Tag Team Champions Mr. Iguana and NXT Women's Champion Lola Vice will look to defend their titles against Joaquin Wilde and La Hiedra, Los Vipers will take on LA Parka, Octagón Jr. and El Fiscal in a Six-Man Tag Team Match, and Galeno will battle Golden Jacket and Galio in a 2-on-1 Handicap Match.

1.name: June 20, 2026
1.overview: On the latest episode of Lucha Libre AAA, El Grande Americano will appear for the first time since Mask vs. Mask Match, Mini Vikingo & El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. take on AAA Latin American Champion El Hijo del Vikingo & Omos, and Rey Fenix is set to put his title on the line against Laredo Kid and Lince Dorado in a AAA Cruiserweight Championship Triple Threat Match.

1.name: June 27, 2026
1.overview: Lola Vice will make history by putting the NXT Women's Championship on the line in Mexico against La Hiedra. Plus, The Psycho Circus is calling out Pagano and Galeno collides with Mecha Wolf.

1.name: Verano De Escándalo | July 25, 2026
1.overview: AAA Verano de Escándalo Week 1 goes LIVE from Aguascalientes with AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio! Plus, the AAA World Mixed Tag Team Championship is on the line as Lola Vice and Mr. Iguana take on La Hiedra and Laredo Kid. In the main event, Dominik Mysterio and El Grande Americano collide with Los Perros del Mal.

1.name: Verano De Escándalo | August 1, 2026
1.overview: Week 2 of AAA Verano de Escándalo from Aguascalientes features AAA World Cruiserweight Championship match as Rey Fenix clashes against Mini Vikingo. Plus, La Parka, Mecha Wolf, and Lince Dorado battle for a spot at Triplemanía and the opportunity to challenge for the AAA Latin American Championship. Also, Galeno teams up with Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. to take on Drago and Dinámico.

1.name: Verano De Escándalo | August 8, 2026
1.overview: AAA Verano de Escándalo Week 3 delivers an epic finale featuring an exclusive interview with Dominik Mysterio and Andrea Bazarte, as he discusses his current ambitions and what’s next for his future. Plus, the AAA Reina de Reinas Championship is on the line as Flammer, Lady Shani, and La Catalina battle for the gold. Also, don’t miss the third qualifier to determine the next challenger for the AAA Latin American Championship at AAA Triplemanía: El Fiscal vs. Psycho Clown vs. Cruz del Toro, along with a one-on-one match between Jack Cartwheel vs. Noisy Boy.

1.name: Triplemanía 34 | September 11, 2026
1.overview: The biggest event in Mexican lucha libre, AAA Triplemania, takes over two spectacular nights! Night 1 comes to the MGM Grand in Las Vegas with huge matchups that will shape Night 2 in Mexico City and the rest of 2026 in AAA.

1.name: Triplemanía 34 | September 13, 2026
1.overview: The spectacular conclusion of AAA Triplemanía takes over Mexico City with the highly anticipated AAA Mega Championship showdown between Dominik Mysterio and El Grande Americano.

1.name: October 3, 2026
1.overview: The new AAA Mega Champion El Grande Americano kicks off the show. Mr. Iguana challenges La Parka in a AAA Latin American Championship Match.

1.name: Héroes Inmortales | October 31, 2026
1.overview: The excitement of AAA Heroes Inmortales continues in Week 2! Los Wagner Brothers defend the AAA World Tag Team Championships against Los Vipers, represented by Taurus and Histeria. Plus, Dave The Clown and Murder Clown team up to take on Pagano and El Carnicero. And Rey Fenix will finally find out who will answer his open challenge for the AAA World Cruiserweight Championship!

1.name: Héroes Inmortales | November 7, 2026
1.overview: AAA Heroes Inmortales comes to an epic conclusion! AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio will induct Lic. Marisela Peña into the AAA Hall of Fame. Plus, Abismo Negro Jr. and El Fiscal face off in a highly anticipated one-on-one match. And Cruz Del Toro, Kento, and Bravo Americano collide in a Triple Threat Match!

overview: WWE Lucha Libre AAA is a Mexican-American professional wrestling television program produced by AAA in partnership with its parent company WWE.
title: WWE Lucha Libre AAA
